title: AE2 Favorites
description: Adds a favorite items feature to AE2 terminals, allowing you to pin items to the very top of the list.
body: # AE2 Favorites ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg) 为 AE2 的终端界面添加了收藏物品的功能，可以将物品固定在所有物品最顶端。 > Adds a favorite items feature to AE2 terminals, allowing you to pin items to the very top of the list. --- ## ✨ 功能 - 在 AE2 终端中按 **Shift + 鼠标中键** 固定/取消固定物品 - 被固定的物品会显示在物品列表的最顶端 - 支持所有 AE2 终端类型（ME 终端、合成终端等） > Press **Shift + Middle Click** to pin/unpin an item in the terminal. > Pinned items will always appear at the top of the list. --- ## 📷 截图 --- ## 📄 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026
